description: Follow flights with FlightAware: get a flight's status, times, gates and delays by its flight number, see an airport's departures and arrivals, find nonstop flights between airports, check airport delays, and start a workflow when a flight's status, gate or times change.

flightaware_flight_status_changed_trigge.description: Runs when a flight's status, gate, terminal, baggage claim or times change: a delay of 5 minutes or more, a gate change, a cancellation, takeoff or landing. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks at most every 15 minutes, and each check is one billed FlightAware query.
